title: [BUG] Sync failure: cannot fetch treatments or pump status under NSV3 (must switch to NSV1 temporarily
body:
**Affected setup / version**

* Branch: `APPSClients-dev-c`
* NSV mode: NSV3 (buggy), NSV1 (works)

**Description / steps to reproduce**

1. Start AAPS client in NSV3
2. Pump status not displayed, no treatment data received
3. Switch to NSV1
4. Treatments and pump status load correctly
5. Switch back to NSV3

Logs sent

comments.body: I did a test. Fresh AAPS client, I went through setup wizard, selected APIv3, entered token and after a while data is synced. It must be an issue on your side
Could it be that 8 client apps and 1 masters are syncing on one databese?
